findings.description: The current I3-FU-1 seed bullet still names `20619000 + 100·part + case` and says the formula and guard are unchanged, although revision 17 supersedes it with `20627200 + 100·part + case`. The later amendment is unambiguous and executable bindings use the new family, so this is documentation drift rather than an evidence-integrity defect. Mark the old statement superseded and add the new family to the plan-text guard assertions.

report.summary: The prior important finding is resolved. Revision 17 consumes the disclosed 20619000-family sample and freezes a previously absent, collision-free 20627200-family for all 116 evidence/repeat bundles. Generator, evaluator, bundle metadata, native TOPAS inputs, manifest hashes, freeze bindings, and source-level regression coverage agree. The five smoke seeds remain non-evidence. Manifest contents and recorded hashes were checked read-only; tests were not executed as instructed. Only minor stale plan wording remains.
